title: Quick Tunisian Sausage Bowl
description: A sweet, light, egg‑free Tunisian dish featuring German sausages, a fragrant tomato‑harissa sauce, and fluffy couscous, all baked in a papillote for a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: In a skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the spice blend and harissa paste and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes and tomato paste, stir to combine, and simmer for 5 minutes until sauce starts to thicken.
Slice the bratwurst into 1-inch pieces and add to the skillet, cooking until browned, about 5 minutes.
While the sausage cooks, prepare couscous by mixing the couscous with 250 ml vegetable broth, cover, and let steam for 5 minutes.
Transfer the tomato‑sausage mixture to a parchment paper pouch, sprinkle with lemon zest and parsley, seal the edges, and bake at 200°C for 10 minutes.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and serve the hot tomato‑sausage pouch over the couscous.
Optional: drizzle a little extra olive oil on top and serve immediately.
